summary: 1935 CCC-built tower in Ferdinand State Forest, Dubois County, Indiana; restored 2009; NHLR-registered July 2026; standing, with climbing status unconfirmed.

facts.design: Tower with wooden steps before the 2009 restoration and a cab at the top; no height in these sources

access.note: Recreation-area access is through the gatehouse only, per the trail map legend, which marks a seasonal gate. No official source found says whether the tower may be climbed.

visit.trail_note: The state trail map marks a trail labelled Fire Tower and asks visitors to stay on marked trails.

events.note: Erected by CCC Company 1513 at Camp F-76; the hobby site gives the same year from the Living New Deal page
Restored in summer 2009 with AARA funds, which the 2009 report says the State of Indiana received to restore lookout towers; wooden steps replaced with treated wood and new fencing installed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources disagree on whether the present tower was moved from the first site or erected where it stands; no source confirms either.

notes_for_editor: Built 1935 by CCC is supported by two sources (NHLR and a hobby site repeating the Living New Deal date). The brief's record had no built event; this adds it. The 2009 restoration money is spelled AARA in the sources and ARRA in the brief record; the story uses the sources' spelling. Current climbing permission is unconfirmed: the only climbing statement is a hobby site, and the DNR map gives no tower rule. Height and staffing dates are not in any source read. Agency is recorded as Indiana Department of Conservation per the Forest Lookouts header; that is an older name and the DNR map is the current state publisher, so check the agency field before publishing.
